decisions.rationale: Accepted independently on exact commit 06e6b6b6d9cbebeb50bdc6166024b57d386c36af. The learner contract requires two equal card columns from 600px and the named page grid from 1000px, not only at sampled widths. Trigger: task 4 renders cards only at 599/600/700px and task 5 renders regions only at 999/1000/1100px, while the source guard accepts every nondecreasing supported minimum-width sequence. Mask: later ordered rules therefore satisfy the source-order guard but activate outside the relevant rendered samples. Learner-visible symptoms: a later 800px rule changing cards to three columns and a later 1200px rule restoring .page to block each received 7 pass/0 fail; Chromium first diverged at exactly 800px and 1200px respectively and remained wrong at wider probes. Canonical, redundant valid 800px two-column, and redundant valid 1200px grid controls remained 7/0 and rendered correctly. Correct this narrowly by deriving supported learner-authored minimum-width boundaries from the existing bounded reader and checking the assessed rendered card and page outcomes at the smallest integer viewport at or above each applicable boundary and at the following pixel, while retaining the documented fixed probes. Scratch guards rejected the two invalid overrides exactly at 800px and 1200px and passed both valid later-rule controls. Preserve the existing eight valid and nineteen invalid route matrix, outcome-first messages, and no-solution-disclosure boundary; do not reject all later breakpoints or build a general CSS parser. No correction exists in the reviewed bytes, so this decision intentionally omits fixedInSha256.

Accepted independently on exact commit 06e6b6b6d9cbebeb50bdc6166024b57d386c36af. Trigger and earliest divergence: parseCss and mediaQueries delete comments with an empty replacement before at-keyword recognition, so valid @media/**/screen is changed into the different token @mediascreen. Mask: Chromium tokenizes the original CSS and applies both wider rules correctly, but both source-reader paths consume the corrupted joined text, causing the source-only page-area and ordering checks to fail. Learner-visible symptom: the valid comment-separated route rendered one/two card columns at 599/600px and block/grid page layouts at 999/1000px through 1300px, yet the public command reported 5 pass/2 fail. The literal @mediascreen disconfirming route was rejected 4/3 and Chromium never applied its wider layouts. Replacing comments with one whitespace character in the two narrow preprocessing calls was the smallest scratch counterfactual: @media/**/screen changed to 7/0, while literal @mediascreen remained 4/3 and canonical syntax remained 7/0. Apply that bounded token-boundary preservation and add a passing comment-separated regression beside the retained failing literal malformed-at-keyword regression. Do not broaden the reader into a general CSS parser, weaken the existing eight-valid/nineteen-invalid matrix, expose completed declarations, or change outcome-first feedback. No correction exists in the reviewed bytes, so this decision intentionally omits fixedInSha256.
